finding: Imprecise on the two points the question asks about. Exclusion (i) is 'orders issued under section 18 of the Army Act' (not Presidential orders generally). Exclusion (iv) excludes SCMs 'except where the punishment is of dismissal or imprisonment for more than three months'. rationale: A commander or practitioner could treat every summary award as within, or outside, AFT jurisdiction.
